# appendRows

<link-summary>Adds rows after the last row that holds data.</link-summary>

<web-summary>appendRows() — Adds rows after the last row that holds data. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/sheet</code> · Since: 1.0.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function appendRows(
  target: GoogleAppsScript.Spreadsheet.Sheet | GoogleAppsScript.Spreadsheet.Range,
  values: unknown,
  options: AppendRowsOptions | null | undefined = {}
): GoogleAppsScript.Spreadsheet.Sheet;
```

Pass a sheet and the whole sheet is examined, with the write starting in column 1; pass a range and only its cells are, with the write landing on the range's columns — data elsewhere on the sheet no longer decides where the block goes.

Nothing is overwritten: the write starts one row below the last one holding data, and `0` and `false` count as data. The sheet gains rows when it is too short for the result. Unlike `Sheet#appendRow`, which takes one row at a time, the whole block is written in a single call.

A cell whose text starts with `=` is written as a formula, not as text — the same rule the editor follows.

## Parameters

| Parameter                     | Type                                                                       | Description                                                                              |
| :---------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `target`                      | `GoogleAppsScript.Spreadsheet.Sheet \| GoogleAppsScript.Spreadsheet.Range` | The sheet to append to, or the range to append within.                                   |
| `values`                      | `unknown`                                                                  | A matrix of rows: one array per row, all of the same length.                             |
| `options` _(optional)_ `= {}` | `AppendRowsOptions \| null \| undefined`                                   | `afterFrozenRows` starts the write below the frozen rows when the data ends before them. |

## Returns

`GoogleAppsScript.Spreadsheet.Sheet` — the sheet, so calls can be chained.

## Throws

| Exception                  | Condition                                              |
| :------------------------- | :----------------------------------------------------- |
| `IllegalArgumentException` | no argument is passed.                                 |
| `InvalidSheetException`    | the first argument is neither a sheet nor a range.     |
| `TypeError`                | the values are not a matrix with rows of equal length. |

## Examples

### Appending to a sheet

```javascript
const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSheet();

appendRows(sheet, [
  ["Ada", "ada@example.com"],
  ["Grace", "grace@example.com"]
]);
```

### Appending within a range

```javascript
const sheet = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSheet();

appendRows(sheet.getRange("B1:C10"), [["Ada", "ada@example.com"]]);
```
